verdict.rationale: Relay offers rule-based background automations (auto-transfer rules, recurring invoices, auto-categorization/sync, approval workflows) that run without manual triggering, which satisfies the 'runs autonomously in background' part of the story, but there is no evidence of AI-driven decision-making or agent-like behavior — these are simple conditional rules, not AI-native automations. Community feedback also notes that some processes (e.g., external payments) still require manual execution despite the automated partitioning. Missing for 10: AI/LLM-driven automation logic, evidence of adaptive or context-aware agentic behavior, and confirmation that all background processes run without manual steps.
